heading: Lake Shore Shorians - Louden
narrative: - In 2013, Larry(Sandusky) brought his son along to join the league. He didn't post too much. Sometimes he had to be reminded that he was in the league, but stuck with us until 2017. He lives in Florida still. During his 5 year run, he made the Playoffs twice finishing 2-2 and making it to Super Bowl 8 with a loss to Simi Valley. He won an Offensive Rookie Award is Season 9 (Kelvin Benjamin). In Season 10, he brought home the Jamarcus Russell trophy. In 5 seasons, 3 of them were winning records. He totaled a 51-44 record during his time. Did he have help?
